newsitem.title: USA: At least 30 killed in Texas tornadoes - police.
newsitem.headline: At least 30 killed in Texas tornadoes - police.

text.p: Officials said at least 30 people were killed and dozens more were injured by tornadoes and powerful thunderstorms that tore through central Texas on Tuesday.
Hardest hit was the small town of Jarrell where Williamson County sheriff Ed Richards said at least 28 people were killed by one huge tornado that flattened dozens of homes.
He said the death toll could rise higher as search teams continued picking through the rubble of at least 50 homes.
"It is total chaos. We'll be searching all night long for more," Richards said. "There is debris everyhwere."

Several tornadoes, accompanied by baseball-sized hail and torrential rain, hit towns and cities across four counties and two people were killed in the state capital of Austin. A girl drowned in a flooded creek and a man was killed when a building collapsed.
In Jarrell, hearses began to line up outside a makeshift morgue at the small town's volunteer firehouse as rescue teams scoured the area for more bodies and possible survivors.
